text: Natural language processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It focuses on text understanding, allowing machines to grasp the meaning behind words, whether in emails, articles, or social media posts. One common use is translation, where tools like online translators convert text between languages instantly. Another important application is sentiment analysis, which determines if a review or comment is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots rely on NLP to have natural conversations with customers, answering questions and solving problems. Thanks to NLP, computers are becoming much better at communicating with us in a way that feels human.
